name: structured_tables
method: ING xlsx appendix read block by block (openpyxl, values only); each Docling table matched to the block holding its informative numbers (non-zero, not a bare integer < 100, not a year) once spreadsheet values are rounded as printed (0-4 decimals, fraction or percentage, sign ignored). Certain = >= 5 informative numbers, >= 95 % of them in the best block, runner-up block >= 0.2 lower. Row level: every Docling row with an informative number finds the one spreadsheet row of that block holding all of its numbers, in the same order.
